Introduction

TMC, short for TooManyColors, is a male duo that debuted in 2023 under MyDoll Entertainment. The duo consists of Wonsik, a former member of Apeace, and Seunghyuk.

They opened their official SNS accounts on November 29, 2022, to introduce themselves to the public. They released their first pre-debut digital single “Color” on June 20, 2023, and announced that they will also release a Japanese version of the song on August 2. On September 6, 2023, TMC announced that their fan club name will be TOUR, which is a combination of TMC and OUR, meaning the fans and TMC will become one and travel together in the future.

On August 22, 2025, it was announced that the group’s name will officially change from TMC to Too Many Color (TMC), beginning with their upcoming song promotions. The abbreviation TMC will remain in use, and the fandom name will also be updated to align with the new team identity. Further details regarding the fandom name change will be revealed at a later time.
